known_service_contract.enforcement: CPU affinity; aggregate process-tree RSS sampled every 50 ms; PID namespace teardown

known_capacity_observations.interpretation: Host MemAvailable exceeds the requested task budget. The reported environment available amount does not establish that the entire requested budget can currently fit. Host cached bytes do not determine environment-specific reclaimable active-file cache.

minimal_v3_conditions: Enter the explicit SERVICE_SAMPLED_RSS_CGROUPFS_UNEXPOSED mode only for the evidenced 0::/ membership with genuinely zero cgroup2 mount rows.
Do not catch a visible-cgroup mapping, permissions, counter, or budget failure and silently downgrade it to the unavailable-filesystem mode; keep the existing visible branch.
Bind the actual service contract and its observation time to the exact request of 12800 MiB, one thread, 3600 seconds, with the original inner 11264 MiB CLI setting.
Repeat runtime host MemAvailable, CPU affinity and the existing disk-floor checks before original CLI exec; keep both checks on the same namespace/resource mode and contract binding.
Report environment current/headroom/reported available and cache observations without deriving invented environment active-file reclaim or adding host cache to environment headroom.

Describe the memory enforcement as sampled process-tree RSS termination under the server contract. Do not describe it as a per-task hard cgroup limit, guaranteed environmental capacity, or reserved memory.
Keep the five original tools, all original pins and proof gates, exact two-root CLI, failure evidence, and no automatic resubmission.
Verify the actual submitted task parameters and eventual process results from the real task record during later acceptance; this design review supplies no runtime PASS.

practical_risk_assessment.main_remaining_risk: An audit can exceed actual available environment capacity or transiently exceed a sampled RSS threshold; it may terminate or leave incomplete audit evidence.
practical_risk_assessment.single_worker_contract_effect: Reduces overlapping managed audit jobs, while not removing shared-service usage or making sampled observations atomic.
practical_risk_assessment.PID_namespace_teardown_effect: Provides the stated cleanup boundary; it is not a memory reservation or prevention guarantee.
practical_risk_assessment.proof_acceptance_effect: Original audit/exit/freshness/inventory/artifact gates still require complete real evidence, so a resource stop must not grant proof credit.
practical_risk_assessment.lower_budget_option: No actual peak for these two comparable audits was supplied. Do not infer sufficiency of a lower 6144-MiB setting from source/object size or from a configured limit. Preserve the already selected 12800/11264 envelope unless applicable measured peak evidence supports another choice.

recommendation: Do not indefinitely block the already authorized single audit solely because the sandbox does not expose cgroup2 files. The minimal explicit server-contract branch is acceptable with the above honest scope and failure behavior. No additional environment investigation or generic resource framework is needed for this decision.
